description: This file defines the 'Translation' class within the 'Opencart' admin controller namespace, responsible for managing language translation tasks such as generating translation task lists, writing translation files, and clearing existing translation files in an OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: A controller class managing translation tasks such as listing translation routes, writing translation files, and clearing translation data within the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a list of translation tasks for all stores and languages, scheduling them for execution.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes the translation data to JSON files for a specified route, store, and language.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Deletes previously generated translation JSON files from language directories across all stores and languages.
